name: omnimux-inspiration
description: OmniMux 官方应用：爆款灵感素材库、热点视频切片与创意提取

tools.name: inspiration_search
tools.summary: Search inspiration items in local vault and public repository by keyword, platform, type, tag or favorite.

tools.name: inspiration_get
tools.summary: Get full details of a single inspiration item including 5-dimension breakdown, script templates and local file paths.

tools.name: inspiration_create
tools.summary: Create and crawl inspiration from social media URLs (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, X), download media and trigger AI analysis.

tools.name: inspiration_rival_accounts
tools.summary: List monitored rival accounts with platform, handle, followers, refresh state and potential post count.

tools.name: inspiration_rival_posts
tools.summary: List the cached posts of one rival account, optionally filtered to the potential-flagged ones only.

tools.name: inspiration_rival_post
tools.summary: Get one rival post with its account, including media urls, stats and library status.

tools.name: inspiration_rival_posts_add_to_session
tools.summary: Build the session attachment payload of one rival post so the workbench can mount it into the active conversation.

tools.name: inspiration_rival_to_inspiration
tools.summary: Import one rival post into the local inspiration library through the existing import-url pipeline.

tools.name: inspiration_rival_refresh
tools.summary: Queue a refresh of one or all rival accounts, bounded by the per-account cloud call budget.
